title: Majorization Problems for Subclasses of Meromorphic Functions Defined by the Generalized q-Sălăgean Operator
content: In this paper the author investigates a majorization problem for certain subclasses of meromorphic functions defined in the punctured unit disk U∗. These subclasses are defined using a combination and iterations of meromorphic functions associated with the generalized q-Salagean operator defined in [1], and the main tool for this investigation is the generalisation of Nehari’s lemma for the Jackson’s q-difference operator ∂q given in [2].
